title: Design System: Jan Edward de Nicolas

slate-ground.purpose: Page and nav background, dark theme.

slate-surface.purpose: The single raised tone: chips, photo backing, hover fills.

hairline.purpose: Row dividers, section rules, chip and photo borders.

hairline-strong.purpose: Control borders, empty meter segments, separators, resting underlines.

muted.purpose: Nav at rest, dates, subheads, metadata.

signal-blue.purpose: Links on hover, active nav underline, meters, inline actions, focus ring.

signal-blue-light.purpose: Interactive text and lines, light theme.

display.purpose: The name in the hero; once per page.

title.purpose: Section headings in the left column.

label.purpose: Nav links, subheads, inline actions, metadata.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Colour, border and underline changes on hover.

themes.print: black on white, nav and actions hidden

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; height: 60px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--bg, #0b1120); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #1e293d); font-family: 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #e6eaf1); } .ds-nav-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 24px; margin-left: auto; } .ds-nav-links a { position: relative; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted, #8c98ad); text-decoration: none; padding: 6px 0; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-links a:hover, .ds-nav-links a[aria-current] { color: var(--ink, #e6eaf1); } .ds-nav-links a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--accent, #6aa9ff); transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-links a[aria-current]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-theme { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: none; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #2c3a54); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--muted, #8c98ad); cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-theme:hover { color: var(--ink, #e6eaf1); border-color: var(--muted, #8c98ad); } .ds-nav-email { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--button, #2563eb); color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-email:hover { background: var(--button-hover, #1d4ed8); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #6aa9ff); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
A single full-width column on a dark slate ground, read top to bottom like a carefully typeset CV. The content is the design: one sans family, one blue, hairline rules between rows, and nothing themed or costumed around it. Structure comes from a consistent two-column section grid (heading left, content right) and from typographic weight, not from cards, panels or ornament.

Density is moderate and scannable. Rows are divided by 1px hairlines; data (dates, rating values) drops into Geist Mono at a small size so it reads as record, not prose. Dark is the default; a light "paper" theme mirrors every role token one-for-one through `[data-theme='light']`. Motion is restrained to colour and underline transitions and one height ease; nothing animates on load.

The benchmark is the polished developer portfolio category (brittanychiang.com, leerob.com) executed at full craft. Conceptual or themed worlds were tried and set aside for this product.
keyCharacteristics: One sans family (Geist) for everything; Geist Mono only for dates and small numeric data.
One blue accent family: a light signal blue for links, active nav, meters and focus; a saturated action blue for filled buttons.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines; a single raised surface tone for chips, photo backing and hover fills.
Heading-left, content-right section grid that collapses to one column on narrow screens.
Dark by default, light theme as a token swap, print stylesheet that strips to black on white.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only hue that signals interaction. Signal blue for text and lines, action blue for fills. No second accent colour; green exists only as the status dot.

rules.name: The Paired Token Rule
rules.body: Every neutral and accent role has a dark and a light value and changes only through `[data-theme]`. Never hard-code a colour in a component; the one exception is white text on action blue.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only on dates and numeric values. Never on headings, labels or body copy.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: All labels and headings are sentence case at normal tracking. No uppercase tracked labels above headings.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px hairline or a one-step surface tone. No shadows, no glass, no gradients.

dos: Do use the paired dark/light role tokens for every colour; add both values when introducing a role.
Do separate content with 1px hairlines and the single slate surface tone.
Do use the heading-left, content-right section grid (180px / fluid, 48px gap) for any new section.
Do keep Geist Mono to dates and numeric values at 13px.
Do keep motion to 200ms colour/underline transitions on the shared ease (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)), with nothing animating on load.
Do pair any graphical indicator (meter, dot) with text that carries the same meaning.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue; blue is the only interactive colour.
Don't use box-shadows, glows, gradients or glass blur for depth.
Don't put uppercase tracked labels or kickers above headings; section titles stand alone.
Don't wrap sections or rows in bordered cards; rows are hairline-divided, not boxed.
Don't use text glyphs or emoji as icons; icons are inline stroke SVGs.
Don't reintroduce themed or metaphorical chrome around the content.
